title: REQ · An engine helper plays the scene's authored fade via the render context
summary: A pure engine helper reads the transition entry and calls ctx.playTransition with its durationMs
description: Context: src/engine/buildEffects.ts filters out transition specs and nothing else reads them. Desired behavior: a helper playSceneTransition(ctx, scene) finds the transition effect in scene.effects and calls ctx.playTransition(durationMs) once, or does nothing when absent. Expected result: the content duration reaches the context. Why: keeps the runtime free of hardcoded durations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene whose effects include {type:'transition',kind:'fade',durationMs:400}, when playSceneTransition runs, then ctx.playTransition is called once with 400
Given a scene with effects but no transition entry, or no effects key, when playSceneTransition runs, then ctx.playTransition is not called
technical_constraints: Use EffectRenderContext and SceneDef types from the engine and state modules
definition_of_done: Helper exists and is covered by unit tests
